_comment: The 5 pinned fixture prompts (docs/phases/phase-0-1.md: short English; longer multi-sentence; code snippet; non-ASCII text; chat-template formatted). 'kind: raw' prompts are fed as plain completion text; 'kind: chat' is rendered through the pinned tokenizer's chat template with enable_thinking=false before tokenization. Changing any string invalidates the committed fixtures.
